report_name: Blinder Tunnel Campaign Targets Iraqi Critical Infrastructure

threat_actors.name: CL-STA-1178
threat_actors.description: An Iranian state-aligned threat actor responsible for the 'Blinder Tunnel' campaign, targeting critical infrastructure in Iraq and other Middle Eastern countries. The actor uses sophisticated social engineering and living-off-the-cloud C2 techniques.
threat_actors.goals: Cyber-espionage and establishing long-term, covert access to high-value targets within the telecommunications, aviation, and other critical infrastructure sectors.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Attachment
attack_patterns.description: The initial access vector involved delivering an Inno Setup installer named 'Dubai Airport Careers' via a social engineering lure impersonating a recruitment process.

attack_patterns.name: User Execution
attack_patterns.description: Targets were lured into executing a malicious installer disguised as a coding assessment, which initiated the infection chain.

attack_patterns.name: AppDomainManager
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor used AppDomainManager hijacking to force a trusted Windows application to load and execute the ShelbyLoader V2 payload in memory, evading detection.

attack_patterns.name: DLL Side-Loading
attack_patterns.description: DLL sideloading was used following AppDomainManager hijacking to establish persistence and further code execution.

attack_patterns.name: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: The malware abused the legitimate GitHub API for command-and-control (C2) communications, a 'living off the cloud' technique to blend malicious traffic with legitimate developer activity.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: The actor used their C2 channel to transfer an in-memory wrapper for the Chisel tunneling utility to the compromised network.

malware.name: ShelbyLoader V2
malware.description: A custom malware family used as the primary payload in the Blinder Tunnel campaign. It is designed for espionage and remote access, and uses the GitHub API for C2.

tools.name: Chisel
tools.description: An open-source tunneling utility that was transferred to compromised systems to bridge the internal network with the attacker's external infrastructure.

campaigns.name: Blinder Tunnel
campaigns.description: A cyber-espionage campaign attributed to the Iranian actor CL-STA-1178, active since March 2026. It targets critical infrastructure in the Middle East using social engineering and a custom malware called ShelbyLoader V2.

identities.name: Dubai Airports
identities.description: Impersonated by the threat actor CL-STA-1178 in a social engineering scheme to lure software engineers with fake job opportunities.

identities.name: Iraqi Critical Infrastructure
identities.description: The primary target sector of the Blinder Tunnel campaign.

identities.name: Israeli Entity
identities.description: An unnamed Israeli entity was targeted in a related campaign by the same threat actor.

infrastructure.name: GitHub C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The campaign used the legitimate GitHub API for command-and-control, making malicious traffic difficult to distinguish from normal developer activity.

indicators.name: Blinder Tunnel Associated Files
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Blinder Tunnel Associated File Execution
id: 2b1a8c3d-f4e5-4b6a-8d7c-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of files associated with the Blinder Tunnel campaign, including the initial lure and the Chisel tunneling tool.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-06
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/blinder-tunnel-targets-critical-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1204
  - attack.t1105
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\Dubai Airport Careers.exe'
      - '\chisel.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the initial installer 'Dubai Airport Careers' or the 'chisel.exe' tunneling tool.

indicators.name: Suspicious CSProj File Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious CSProj File Execution
id: 5d6e7f8a-9b0c-4d1e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Monitors for the execution of C# project files (.csproj) outside of legitimate development tools, which was a TTP in the Blinder Tunnel campaign.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-06
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/blinder-tunnel-targets-critical-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1204
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: '.csproj'
  filter:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\devenv.exe'
      - '\msbuild.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects the execution of .csproj files by non-standard parent processes, a technique used in the Blinder Tunnel campaign.

indicators.name: AppDomainManager Hijacking Indicator
indicators.pattern:
title: AppDomainManager Hijacking via mscoree.dll Load
id: 8a9b0c1d-2e3f-4a5b-6c7d-8e9f0a1b2c3d
status: experimental
description: Detects processes that are not part of the .NET framework unexpectedly loading mscoree.dll, which can be an indicator of AppDomainManager hijacking as seen in the Blinder Tunnel campaign.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-06
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/blinder-tunnel-targets-critical-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1574.014
level: medium
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\mscoree.dll'
  filter:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\'
      - 'C:\Program Files\dotnet\'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects the loading of mscoree.dll by unexpected applications, which is a sign of potential AppDomainManager hijacking.

indicators.name: Anomalous GitHub API C2 Traffic
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous GitHub API C2 Traffic
id: 1d2e3f4a-5b6c-4d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: 'Scrutinizes traffic to the GitHub API from non-developer workstations or servers, which could indicate C2 communications similar to the Blinder Tunnel campaign.'
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-06
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/blinder-tunnel-targets-critical-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
level: low
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host: 'api.github.com'
  filter:
    c-useragent|contains:
      - 'git/'
      - 'Visual Studio'
      - 'Go-http-client'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects traffic to api.github.com from sources that are not typical developer workstations, a potential indicator of C2 activity.
